strategy: Systematic cross-sectional momentum, long/short, with a market hedge
asset_class: US large-cap equities (cash shares) plus SPY for the hedge
universe: About 100 S&P 500 large caps across all 11 GICS sectors (fixed list in fund/engine/universe.py)
execution: Paper fills at the official daily close, after the session has closed

books.long: Strongest 12-1 momentum, above the 200-day average. Stop 12%.
books.short: Weakest 12-1 momentum, below the 200-day average, not crowded (short interest at most 10% of float). Stop 10%: losses on a short are unbounded.
books.hedge: SPY sized each day so the beta-adjusted net exposure stays near 0%.

sign_off: Systematic trades inside this mandate are signed in advance by the standing rules. Any trade the checks flag waits for a manual PM sign-off.
not_in_scope: Real money, leverage beyond 150% gross, options, borrow costs, intraday execution
